name: Crosswise
rootCause: Decentralized trading platform Crosswise was attacked in nearly an hour, losing about $879,000. The hacker exploited a publicly exposed privileged function, which was then used to set trustedForwarder and further hijack Crosswise's owner privileges. The stolen funds have now been transferred to Tornado Cash for mixing.

descriptions.text: Decentralized trading platform Crosswise was attacked in nearly an hour, losing about $879,000. The hacker exploited a publicly exposed privileged function, which was then used to set trustedForwarder and further hijack Crosswise's owner privileges. The stolen funds have now been transferred to Tornado Cash for mixing.

Crosswise Finance suffered a $879,000 loss on BNB Chain on 18 January 2022 when an attacker exploited improper access controls in the MasterChef contract to take ownership, deploy a malicious strategy, and withdraw CRSS tokens. The MasterChef contract's access control mechanism failed because critical privilege checks relied on an insecure implementation of _msgSender. The setTrustedForwarder function was publicly accessible without adequate permission checks, allowing the attacker to become owner and execute pool withdrawals.
